subject: pclxs: sv_reftype truncates a long class name into a static buffer
description: src/sv.c pclxs_sv_reftype copies the stash name into a `static char classbuf[256]` — truncating a class name >=255 chars into a silently wrong answer (the newCONSTSUB shape again), and the static means two calls in one expression alias each other. Perl returns HvNAME(SvSTASH(sv)), stable and unbounded. Fix with an oracle case.
